name: MedBench
intro: MedBench论文v1提出面向中文医疗大模型的综合评测体系：整合8个公开数据集并自建12个数据集，共300,901道题，覆盖43个临床专业和五个能力维度；云端评测从中平衡采样8,913条，并以题目/标准答案物理隔离、选项循环打乱和随机提示匹配减少捷径。当前官网已升级为v5，不能作为论文v1的可复现实现版本。
org: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Ruijin Hospital
build_method: 公开数据整合, 专家构建, 医生核验, 动态评测
openness: 公开评测平台；完整快照与数据许可证未披露
eval_feature: 五维综合评测, 43个临床专业, 选项循环打乱, 随机提示匹配
openness_en: Public evaluation platform; full snapshot and dataset license undisclosed
build_method_en: Public-data integration, expert construction, physician verification, dynamic evaluation
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional evaluation, 43 clinical specialties, circular choice shuffling, random prompt matching
intro_en: MedBench paper v1 defines a comprehensive Chinese medical LLM evaluation system: eight public plus twelve constructed datasets yield 300,901 questions across 43 specialties and five dimensions. The cloud evaluation draws a balanced 8,913-item snapshot and reduces shortcuts through physical question/gold separation, circular choice shuffling, and random prompt matching. The current official site has advanced to v5 and is not a reproducible implementation revision of paper v1.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source audit pinned MedBench to arXiv:2407.10990v1, the paper's only version (PDF SHA-256 2b29885d3088f8470ef813b658549e7ce65bff6f4f5e40cd5c0345212eef90b6). No public paper-v1 source repository, downloadable raw-corpus revision, evaluator implementation, or dataset license was identified. The official live service observed on 2026-07-21 served front-end asset index-Qjsr4fSX.js, targets periodVersion v5, and its unauthenticated dataset API listed 36 LLM, 12 VLM, 11 agent, and four atomic datasets; it is therefore shown only as version drift, never as evidence for paper-v1 implementation details. Paper Sections 2.1-2.3 support the five MLU/MLG/MKQA/CMR/HSE dimensions; seven CBLUE datasets plus CMB-Clin; twelve constructed datasets sourced from exams, textbooks, and clinical histories; the collection/screening/rewriting/compilation/verification stages; integrity, representativeness, age distribution, department coverage, semantic accuracy, and privacy controls; verification by two physicians with over ten years' experience; and the special DDx-basic/DDx-advanced/MedTreat route in which one senior physician rewrites to SCARE 2023 and two additional senior physicians must both approve case quality and option reasonableness. The paper fixes the corpus at 300,901 Chinese questions over 20 datasets and 43 specialties, then generates a balanced random 8,913-record evaluation snapshot that covers extremely small datasets, samples representative questions from large datasets, and refreshes every three months. The cloud workflow physically separates questions and gold answers, applies exhaustive circular choice shuffling with every circular rotation required for credit, and randomly matches a prompt from a pool for each question, with K=3 used in the demonstration. Table 1 routes datasets to Accuracy, normalized 0-100 BLEU and ROUGE-L, or Micro-F1; dimension scores average datasets within a dimension and the total is the arithmetic mean of the five reported dimension scores. The paper does not publish the prompt pool, RNG seeds, model-output parser, invalid/missing-output treatment, tokenizer/metric implementation, or precise per-metric denominator, so the diagrams mark these as undisclosed rather than inventing them. Section 2.5 separately validates rankings on 50 questions from five datasets and five models with three blinded senior physicians; ranks receive five through one points and are not part of the MedBench total score. Formal publication evidence [site-a11s-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 5525×1001 (English) and 5525×1001 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 5523×999 and 5523×999. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
